description: Dark Triad , frequently used interchangeably with Blackpill or Lookism , refers to a controversial internet aesthetic and TikTok-based online subculture that surfaced around 2023. Although the term was originally strictly tied to psychology, it represents a visual and cultural shift where the "Dark Triad" traits (narcissism, Machiavellianism, and psychopathy) are reimagined as a "high-status" or attractive masculine archetype. The aesthetic is heavily associated with looksmaxxing culture, black-and-white digital editing, and the glorification of antisocial or predatory behavior.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Ruthless discipline, social manipulation, emotional detachment, physical perfectionism, "dark" charisma
